==== src/VerifySample.Tests/ModuleInitializer.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=Cosmos&min=Cosmos&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Extensions/CosmosTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=Cosmos&min=Cosmos&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using Microsoft.Azure.Cosmos;
using Microsoft.Azure.Cosmos.Linq;

// Verify.Cosmos: Snapshots Azure Cosmos DB responses with diagnostics, ETags and policy metadata left out.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.Cosmos
// Note: Initialize() ignores the member ETag on every type, not only on Cosmos types, so an ETag
// elsewhere in a snapshot disappears too.
// Note: RequestCharge stays in the snapshot, rounded to one decimal place, and can change when the
// service version changes.
// Note: Diagnostics, IndexingPolicy, ContainerProperties and DatabaseProperties are ignored with
// no way to opt back in.
public class CosmosTests
{
    // The response is snapshotted with its status code and the stored document, while the
    // diagnostics, the ETag and the policy metadata, which differ on every call, are left out.
    // Not run by default: needs a Cosmos DB account or the Azure Cosmos DB Emulator listening on
    // localhost, with its key in a CosmosKey environment variable.
    [Fact(Skip = "needs a Cosmos DB account or the Azure Cosmos DB Emulator listening on localhost, with its key in a CosmosKey environment variable.")]
    public async Task ItemResponse()
    {
        var container = GetContainer();
        var family = new Family
        {
            Id = "Andersen",
            LastName = "Andersen"
        };

        var response = await container.CreateItemAsync(family, new PartitionKey(family.LastName));

        await Verify(response);
    }

    // The emulator's endpoint. The key is read from the environment rather than hard coded.
    static Container GetContainer()
    {
        var client = new CosmosClient(
            "https://localhost:8081",
            Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("CosmosKey")!);
        return client.GetContainer("SampleDatabase", "Families");
    }
}

==== interactions

Warning external-tool: Cosmos needs A Cosmos DB endpoint: The samples read the key from a CosmosKey environment variable and talk to https://localhost:8081, where the Azure Cosmos DB Emulator listens.
